name: {{name}}
tagline: Three in a row. Live, or one move a day.
description: Classic tic-tac-toe on the XApps shared match state: play live, take your turns over days, or practice against a bot. Friends can watch.
howTo: X moves first, then you take turns.
Get three of your marks in a row — across, down or diagonal.
A full board with no line is a draw.
